doc: Stockist and Distributor Agreement – Standard Terms
q: How much notice ends a stockist agreement?
reference: 60 days' written notice by either party without cause; immediate for material breach or payment default over 90 days.

A.answer: The standard notice is **60 days' written notice** for termination without cause. Other situations end the agreement immediately (material breach, payment default >90 days) or automatically (licence cancellation) [1].

cited.title: Stockist and Distributor Agreement – Standard Terms
cited.text:
### 9. Termination

| **Situation**                                                                                            | **Notice**                                                  |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Either party, without cause                                                                              | **60 days' written notice**                                 |
| Material breach (diversion, sale of samples, spurious or tampered stock, two failed storage inspections) | Immediate, by written notice from Sanjeevani                |
| Payment default more than 90 days past due                                                               | Immediate, under the Stockist Credit and Collections Policy |
| Licence cancelled or suspended                                                                           | Automatic, from the date of cancellation                    |

9.1 On termination, saleable stock with at least 12 months of shelf life remaining is bought back at the price paid, less 5% handling. The security deposit is refunded within 30 days after all dues are settled.

B.answer: Either party can end the agreement without cause by giving **60 days' written notice** [1]. Other situations (material breach, payment default >90 days, licence cancellation) allow immediate or automatic termination [1].

doc: Master Services Agreement – Harbor Logistics Inc.
q: How much notice is needed to not renew the Harbor Logistics MSA?
reference: Written notice at least 90 days before the end of the term (by 2 July 2026); the MSA does not renew automatically.

A.answer: A party that does not intend to renew must give written notice at least **90 days before the end of the term** (by 2 July 2026 for the current term ending 30 September 2026) [1].

cited.title: Master Services Agreement – Harbor Logistics Inc.
cited.text:
## 2. Term and renewal

- Initial term: three years, from 1 October 2023 to 30 September 2026.
- No automatic renewal. The MSA ends on 30 September 2026 unless the parties sign a renewal or extension.
- Notice of non-renewal: a party that does not intend to renew must give the other party written notice at least 90 days before the end of the term, that is, by 2 July 2026. Neither party has given such notice.
- Holdover: if no renewal is signed by the end of the term, services continue month to month for up to 90 days at the then-current rates, while the parties negotiate.
- Annual escalation: rates increase by 3% on each 1 October anniversary.
